author: HBO Max
description:
Hello, hello, hello! The Comeback Official Podcast is coming. Hosted by Evan Ross Katz, the podcast reunites The Comeback co-creators Lisa Kudrow and Michael Patrick King to revisit the HBO cult classic comedy and the unforgettable world of Valerie Cherish. Each week, the creators look back at the origins of the series, their writing process, and the moments that helped make The Comeback one of HBO’s most beloved and ahead-of-its-time comedies. Evan will also speak with Season 3 cast members including Laura Silverman, Ella Stiller, Abbi Jacobson, and John Early about their experiences working on the show and what it means to be part of the Valerie Cherish universe. New episodes drop weekly on HBO Max and wherever you get your podcasts.
